versions.changelog:
- Improved automation: now extracts keywords from TeX files and searches Google Scholar for relevant papers.
- Automatically generates BibTeX entries for new references and inserts them into the project's .bib file.
- Adds citation markers to key sections (introduction, related work, methods) without duplicating existing citations.
- Creates a detailed ADD.MD report listing all added references and their locations.
- Supports Overleaf project directory structure and backs up the project before making changes.
- New parameters now allow setting the number of references and customizing the report path.
